scope: Frozen v1 results only; validation and official kept separate
competitor_scope: Measured RoarGraph M48/M96 and MLANN RF10/depth14, plus RF80/depth13 when complete; not the entire VIBE roster
hardware: writerslogic-02; Intel Core Ultra 9 185H; Linux/WSL2; AVX2; no AVX-512
resource_limits: Main process RSS aggregates all resident arms; encoded bytes are not persisted file size. Build times are single observations.

attributes.qag_construction_policy: identical 32768 construction learn rows in both phases

protocol.qps: query_count / sum(saved raw per-query fifth-pass times); best_qps ignored
protocol.selection: fastest measured median with minimum strict ID recall across repetitions >= target; no interpolation or rounding
protocol.epsilon_recall: float64 original-metric distance <= recomputed true kth distance + 0.001
protocol.resources: per-arm build seconds/encoded bytes where recorded; process RSS and VIBE USS delta aggregate all co-resident arms
